title: A major layer-1 chain will pause new transactions for 24 minutes to unlock a 10x speed boost
summary:
Supernova is scheduled for Sept. 10 at round 32157661, while the public node feed had yet to show upgrade adoption as the window opened.
The post A major layer-1 chain will pause new transactions for 24 minutes to unlock a 10x speed boost appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: A major layer-1 blockchain network has announced a scheduled maintenance window involving a pause on new transactions. Lasting approximately 24 minutes, the downtime is designed to implement an upgrade intended to deliver a 10x speed improvement for the platform. The update, known as Supernova, was set to occur at a specific network round, though initial reports indicated that node adoption metrics were still updating as the maintenance period commenced.

title: Strategy challenges MSCI’s ‘non-operating’ label – What changes for MSTR?
summary: Analysts had previously warned that other indices could follow MSCI and delist MSTR and other DATs.
content: MicroStrategy is facing increased scrutiny following MSCI's decision to label the company's holdings as non-operating assets. This reclassification has sparked concerns among market analysts regarding the potential for other index providers to follow suit. Such a move could lead to the removal of MicroStrategy and similar digital asset treasury companies from major indices, creating uncertainty about the future inclusion of these entities in institutional investment benchmarks.

title: HYPE treasury firm Hyperliquid Strategies boosts equity facility to $2.5B
summary: The Nasdaq-listed company previously raised $647 million through the facility and accumulated about 29.3 million HYPE tokens.
content: Hyperliquid Strategies has officially expanded its equity facility to $2.5 billion. The Nasdaq-listed treasury firm previously utilized the facility to raise $647 million in capital. As part of its broader financial strategy, the company has also accumulated approximately 29.3 million HYPE tokens. This increase in the equity facility marks a significant update to the firm's balance sheet management and ongoing investment activities.

title: Artificial Intelligence Token Prices Fall More Than 50%
summary: Artificial intelligence token prices have fallen more than 50% since summer, with AI token prices now sitting at…
content: Artificial intelligence-related cryptocurrency tokens have experienced a significant market downturn, with prices declining by more than 50 percent since this past summer. The sector, which saw rapid growth during earlier market phases, is now facing a period of correction. Analysts point to shifting investor sentiment and broader market volatility as primary factors influencing the current valuation of these digital assets as they retreat from their previous peak levels.

The post Bitcoin Flashes the Bart Simpson Pattern After a 25% August Rally appeared first on BeInCrypto.
content: Bitcoin has recently experienced a partial reversal following a significant rally in August. Technical analysts have identified the emergence of a so-called Bart Simpson pattern on the cryptocurrency's price charts. This specific formation has raised concerns among market observers that the current downward trend may continue further. The asset is currently consolidating after reaching its previous monthly highs as traders monitor the price action for further signs of volatility.

title: OpenAI says its new 'Astra' AI can build attacks without human help
summary: Astra is the first OpenAI model to reach its “Critical” cybersecurity threshold, meaning it can find previously unknown vulnerabilities and develop ways to exploit them across hardened systems.
content: OpenAI has introduced a new artificial intelligence model called Astra, marking the first time one of its systems has reached a critical cybersecurity threshold. According to the company, Astra is capable of independently finding previously unknown vulnerabilities and developing exploitation methods across hardened systems without human assistance.

title: From Wallets to Wagers: Crypto’s New Betting Frontier
summary:

Cryptocurrency has moved beyond investment portfolios and online shopping into another fast-growing digital arena: betting. Instead of depositing money through a bank or card provider, users can fund an account from a crypto wallet and place wagers using assets such as Bitcoin, Ether, or stablecoins. This change does not simply replace one payment method with …
content: Cryptocurrency is increasingly being utilized in the online betting sector, transitioning from a niche asset into a common funding method. Users can now bypass traditional banking institutions by linking crypto wallets directly to betting platforms. By utilizing assets like Bitcoin, Ether, and stablecoins, participants are engaging in wagering activities that leverage digital currency infrastructure, signaling a significant shift in how online gambling transactions are processed and executed across the global digital marketplace.
